SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_urgency(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	targetq1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	targetq2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	targetq3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	targetq4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_urgency WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmz_service;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmz_service(KEY (hospcode,pid,seq,date_serv)) AS
SELECT s.*
FROM tmp_accident a 
INNER JOIN tmp_service s ON a.hospcode=s.hospcode AND a.pid=s.pid  AND a.seq=s.seq
	AND DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%Y%m%d')=s.date_serv;

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmz_admit;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmz_admit(KEY (hospcode,pid,seq)) AS
SELECT a.*
FROM tmp_admission a 
WHERE (dischtype IN(8,9) OR dischstatus IN(9) ) ;


INSERT IGNORE INTO s_urgency
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode ,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%m') IN(10,11,12) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),null)) as targetq1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%m') IN(10,11,12) AND (s.typeout in(4,5,6) OR  m.dischtype IN(8,9) OR m.dischstatus IN(9) OR d.cid is not NULL)  ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) resultq1

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%m') IN(1,2,3) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),null)) as targetq2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%m') IN(1,2,3) AND (s.typeout in(4,5,6) OR  m.dischtype IN(8,9) OR m.dischstatus IN(9) OR d.cid is not NULL)  ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) resultq2

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%m') IN(4,5,6) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),null)) as targetq3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%m') IN(4,5,6) AND (s.typeout in(4,5,6) OR  m.dischtype IN(8,9) OR m.dischstatus IN(9) OR d.cid is not NULL)  ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) resultq3

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%m') IN(7,8,9) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),null)) as targetq4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%m') IN(7,8,9) AND (s.typeout in(4,5,6) OR  m.dischtype IN(8,9) OR m.dischstatus IN(9) OR d.cid is not NULL)  ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) resultq4

FROM tmp_accident a 
INNER JOIN 
(SELECT hcode FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear in(@b_year+543) AND splevel   IN('A','S','M1')  AND splevel is not null GROUP BY hcode ) c 
on a.hospcode=c.hcode
INNER JOIN chospital h ON a.hospcode=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON a.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND a.PID=p.PID
INNER JOIN tmz_service s ON a.hospcode=s.hospcode AND a.pid=s.pid AND a.seq=s.seq AND DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%Y%m%d')=s.date_serv
LEFT JOIN tmz_admit m ON  a.hospcode=m.hospcode AND a.pid=m.pid AND a.seq=m.seq AND  TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,a.DATETIME_SERV,m.DATETIME_DISCH) <= 1
LEFT JOIN tmp_death d ON  a.hospcode=d.hospcode AND a.pid=d.pid  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,a.DATETIME_SERV,d.ddeath)<=1
WHERE URGENCY in(1) AND DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY a.hospcode
);
rows.aname: จำนวนผู้เจ็บป่วยวิกฤตฉุกเฉินที่เสียชีวิตภายใน 24 ชั่วโมง
rows.bname: จำนวนผู้เจ็บป่วยวิกฤตฉุกเฉินทั้งหมด
rows.notice:
- ผู้เจ็บป่วยวิกฤตฉุกเฉิน หมายถึง ผู้มารับบริการ ณ ห้องฉุกเฉิน(แฟ้ม Accident) และได้รับการคัดแยก
เป็น Triage Level 1( Field URGENCY เป็น 1)
- การเสียชีวิตภายใน 24 ชั่วโมง หมายถึง นับจากเวลาที่ผู้ป่วยมาห้องฉุกเฉินถึงเวลาที่
เสียชีวิต (Door to Death) ภายใน 24 ชั่วโมง ซึ่งรวมถึงการเสียชีวิตในห้องฉุกเฉิน
- ผู้เจ็บป่วยเสียชีวิตจากแฟ้ม DEATH, SERVICE, ADMISSION เชื่อมโยงด้วยรหัสบัตรประชาชน

SET @prov_c := ( SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1 );
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmz_service;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmz_service(KEY (hospcode,pid,seq,date_serv)) AS
SELECT s.*
FROM tmp_accident a 
INNER JOIN tmp_service s ON a.hospcode=s.hospcode AND a.pid=s.pid  AND a.seq=s.seq
	AND DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%Y%m%d')=s.date_serv;

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmz_admit;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmz_admit(KEY (hospcode,pid,seq)) AS
SELECT a.*
FROM tmp_admission a 
WHERE (dischtype IN(8,9) OR dischstatus IN(9) ) ;

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx (PRIMARY KEY(hospcode,pid,seq)) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 IGNORE  AS
SELECT 
 p.hospcode,p.pid,p.CID,p.NAME,p.LNAME,p.BIRTH,p.SEX,p.NATION,p.check_typearea
,p.addr,p.check_vhid,p.DISCHARGE
,a.SEQ,a.DATETIME_SERV,a.URGENCY,a.AETYPE,a.AEPLACE
,IF(s.typeout in(4,5,6),s.date_serv,NULL ) AS  death_op
,IF(s.typeout in(4,5,6),s.hospcode,NULL ) AS  death_op_hosp
,IF(m.dischtype IN(8,9) OR m.dischstatus IN(9) ,m.DATETIME_DISCH,NULL ) AS  death_ip
,IF(m.dischtype IN(8,9) OR m.dischstatus IN(9) ,m.HOSPCODE,NULL ) AS  death_ip_hosp
,IF(d.CID is not NULL ,d.ddeath,NULL ) AS  death_death
,IF(d.CID is not NULL ,d.HOSPDEATH,NULL ) AS  death_death_hosp
,IF(d.CID is not NULL ,d.HOSPCODE,NULL ) AS  death_death_hosp_input
FROM tmp_accident a 
INNER JOIN 
(SELECT hcode FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear in(@b_year+543) AND splevel   IN('A','S','M1')  AND splevel is not null GROUP BY hcode ) c 
on a.hospcode=c.hcode
INNER JOIN chospital h ON a.hospcode=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON a.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND a.PID=p.PID
INNER JOIN tmz_service s ON a.hospcode=s.hospcode AND a.pid=s.pid AND a.seq=s.seq AND DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%Y%m%d')=s.date_serv
LEFT JOIN tmz_admit m ON  a.hospcode=m.hospcode AND a.pid=m.pid AND a.seq=m.seq AND  TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,a.DATETIME_SERV,m.DATETIME_DISCH) <= 1
LEFT JOIN tmp_death d ON  a.hospcode=d.hospcode AND a.pid=d.pid  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,a.DATETIME_SERV,d.ddeath)<=1
WHERE URGENCY in(1,2) AND DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_SERV,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY a.HOSPCODE,a.PID,a.SEQ;
 
SELECT
h.hoscode,h.hosname,d.pid,d.CID,d.NAME,d.LNAME,d.BIRTH,d.SEX,d.NATION,d.check_typearea,d.addr,d.check_vhid,d.DISCHARGE
,d.SEQ,d.DATETIME_SERV,d.URGENCY,d.AETYPE,d.AEPLACE
,d.death_op,d.death_op_hosp
,d.death_ip,d.death_ip_hosp
,d.death_death,d.death_death_hosp,d.death_death_hosp_input
FROM tx d 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("targetq1"+"targetq2"+"targetq3"+"targetq4") as "target" ,SUM("resultq1"+"resultq2"+"resultq3"+"resultq4") as "result" ,SUM("targetq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("targetq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("targetq3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("resultq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("targetq4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("resultq4") as "resultq4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

province.label: จังหวัด
province.query: SELECT h.chw_code as a_code,h.chw_name as a_name, SUM("targetq1"+"targetq2"+"targetq3"+"targetq4") as "target" ,SUM("resultq1"+"resultq2"+"resultq3"+"resultq4") as "result" ,SUM("targetq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("targetq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("targetq3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("resultq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("targetq4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("resultq4") as "resultq4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.chw_code, h.chw_name ORDER BY h.chw_code

ampur.query: SELECT h.amp_code as a_code,h.amp_name as a_name, SUM("targetq1"+"targetq2"+"targetq3"+"targetq4") as "target" ,SUM("resultq1"+"resultq2"+"resultq3"+"resultq4") as "result" ,SUM("targetq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("targetq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("targetq3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("resultq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("targetq4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("resultq4") as "resultq4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.amp_code, h.amp_name ORDER BY h.amp_code

tambon.label: ตำบล
tambon.query: SELECT h.tmb_code as a_code,h.tmb_name as a_name, SUM("targetq1"+"targetq2"+"targetq3"+"targetq4") as "target" ,SUM("resultq1"+"resultq2"+"resultq3"+"resultq4") as "result" ,SUM("targetq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("targetq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("targetq3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("resultq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("targetq4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("resultq4") as "resultq4" FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.tmb_code, h.tmb_name ORDER BY h.tmb_code

moo.label: หมู่
moo.query: SELECT s.areacode as a_code ,CASE WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 7 THEN SUBSTRING(s.areacode FROM 7 FOR 1) WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 8 THEN SUBSTRING(s.areacode FROM 7 FOR 2) ELSE 'ไม่ระบุ' END AS a_name, SUM("targetq1"+"targetq2"+"targetq3"+"targetq4") as "target" ,SUM("resultq1"+"resultq2"+"resultq3"+"resultq4") as "result" ,SUM("targetq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("targetq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("targetq3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("resultq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("targetq4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("resultq4") as "resultq4" FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY s.areacode ORDER BY s.areacode

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name , SUM("targetq1"+"targetq2"+"targetq3"+"targetq4") as "target" ,SUM("resultq1"+"resultq2"+"resultq3"+"resultq4") as "result" ,SUM("targetq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("targetq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("targetq3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("resultq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("targetq4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("resultq4") as "resultq4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE h.hostype IN('05','06','07','11','12','15') AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.hoscode, h.hosname ORDER BY h.hoscode

service_plan.query: SELECT h.splevel as a_code ,h.splevel as a_name ,   		 SUM(targetq1+targetq2+targetq3+targetq4) as target     		,SUM(resultq1+resultq2+resultq3+resultq4) as result     ,SUM(targetq1) as targetq1 ,SUM(resultq1) as resultq1     ,SUM(targetq2) as targetq2 ,SUM(resultq2) as resultq2     ,SUM(targetq3) as targetq3 ,SUM(resultq3) as resultq3     ,SUM(targetq4) as targetq4 ,SUM(resultq4) as resultq4 FROM (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear={{YEAR}}) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hcode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital as c ON c.hoscode = h.hcode WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (c.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (c.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (c.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (h.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(regbed AS DECIMAL) DESC
